name: @crucible/ci-templates
description: Reusable CI templates (e.g. crucible.yml) that enforce verify on the target branch. Shipped as data, validated by tests.
//: The built core CLI loads this package under plain Node in consumer CI, so its runtime export is dist/index.js. TypeScript checks run before build, so declarations remain source-visible. `crucible init` copies the crucible.yml data into a target repo's .github/workflows/.
